messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Canary rollout started for release/2026-03-15 04:10 UTC — route=canary-routing-exp variant=v2 (triggered by Tess)

Priya: got paged by PD, looking into 5xx spike on canary.

Priya: dashboards show 5xx rate jumped to ~6% on canary tier in the last 3m, latency up too. Abort thresholds at 3%/5m.

Jamal: I'm seeing the same on logs, error class mostly upstream 503/connection_reset.

Casey: FYI the canary included the new connection-pool sizing change + routing fallback. commit abc123.

Priya: can we trigger the kill-switch for the routing-experiment flag? We should stop traffic to v2.

Tess: deploy-bot, abort rollout and remove canary weight.

deploy-bot: Starting canary abort procedure — removing traffic weight from v2 -> v1. Will post updates.

Morgan: scaling up v1 replicas by +2 while we shift traffic back, to reduce latency impact.

Jamal: pulling a sample trace: shows repeated TLS handshake resets and immediate 503s from v2 nodes. Looks related to connection churn.

Priya: posting quick log snippet — can someone grep for connection_reset across the canary hosts?

Casey: here's one from host canary-03:

```
2026-03-15T04:12:37Z ERROR http-handler connection_reset: remote=10.4.2.9:52312 path=/v1/generate id=xyzabc status=503
2026-03-15T04:12:38Z WARN  pool-manager overflow: pool_size=64 used=65 pid=1284
```

Priya: that pool-manager overflow line is concerning — commit abc123 bumped default_pool to 64.

Diego: customer-impact check — we have a handful of customers using streaming chat via the hosted API in region-us-west. Support, any user-facing alerts?

support-bot: Created INC-2026-0315-18 in Statuspage (customers may see intermittent 503s for text generation in US-WEST). Notified support when we have more info.

Priya: decision: kill routing-experiment flag and abort canary. Rollback of the connection-pool change is the next step unless we can patch quickly.

Tess: I can open the rollback PR now and push a hotfix to revert pool sizing. Jamal — can you validate a patch before we flip traffic back?

Jamal: I will run a quick smoke on staging mirror. Also will add a guard to prevent pool_size > 48 for now.

deploy-bot: Canary traffic removed from v2; v1 now handling 100% of traffic. Monitoring for error rate and latency.

Priya: error rate on the platform dropped to 0.6% within 90s after abort. Latency trending back to baseline. Good.

Morgan: keeping extra v1 capacity for 15m while we run the rollback and tests.

Casey: noting: the pool change passed unit tests but not the integration for high-concurrency streaming. We'll include an integration test in the follow-up.

Diego: Product note — customers with long streaming sessions likely affected. We should prepare a short public note once we have root cause and ETA.

Priya: on-call handoff: I'm patching the rollback and will hand to Jamal after the PR merges for validation. Jamal, you'll take next 2 hours.

Jamal: ack taking handoff. I'll validate the rollback and confirm canary re-run controls.

Tess: PR opened: revert abc123 -> PR#4521. Rolling it to staging now.

Priya: quick checklist before we close thread: 1) kill flag (done) 2) abort canary (done) 3) rollback PR opened (done) 4) support ticket created (INC-2026-0315-18) 5) postmortem owner?

Diego: I'll own the postmortem write-up with Engineering help.

support-bot: Updating statuspage to reflect mitigation: traffic routed back to stable, investigating root cause.

Morgan: I'll follow up with a perf test for pool sizes once rollback is merged.

Priya: final note — no escalations to on-call manager needed, incident mitigated, customers have degraded but restored. Jamal take it from here.

Jamal: thanks — I'll keep monitoring and will post a short summary when rollback validated.

Priya: handing off. /me signs out. :white_check_mark:

Jamal: quick summary (will add to INC): canary introduced pool_size change -> pool overflow under high concurrency -> connection resets -> elevated 5xx -> abort criteria triggered -> kill switch + abort -> rollback PR opened. Action items: revert change, add integration test, limit pool_size, postmortem.

Priya: closing realtime thread; will reopen if errors recur.
